mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reconciliation_transaction_summary (shop_id, bill_date, total_income, total_refund, fee_amount, fee_return_amount, income_count, refund_count, total_count) VALUES (#{item.shopId}, #{item.billDate}, #{item.totalIncome}, #{item.totalRefund}, #{item.feeAmount}, #{item.feeReturnAmount}, #{item.incomeCount}, #{item.refundCount}, #{item.totalCount})

INSERT INTO reconciliation_transaction_flow (shop_id, bill_date, transaction_time, order_no, merchant_order_no, order_id, order_type, type, amount, service_fee, product_name, total_quantity, user_id, order_user, remark, orderno, origin_merchant_order_no, origin_orderno) VALUES
(#{it.shopId}, #{it.billDate}, #{it.transactionTime}, #{it.orderNo}, #{it.merchantOrderNo}, #{it.orderId}, #{it.orderType}, #{it.type}, #{it.amount}, #{it.serviceFee}, #{it.productName}, #{it.totalQuantity}, #{it.userId}, #{it.orderUser}, #{it.remark}, #{it.orderno}, #{it.originMerchantOrderNo}, #{it.originOrderno})

INSERT INTO reconciliation_subledger_summary (shop_id, bill_date, total_divide_amount, total_handling_charge, total_platform_charge, total_count) VALUES (#{item.shopId}, #{item.billDate}, #{item.totalDivideAmount}, #{item.totalHandlingCharge}, #{item.totalPlatformCharge}, #{item.totalCount})

where.if: AND (order_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{data.orderNo},'%') OR merchant_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{data.orderNo},'%'))
AND (orderno LIKE CONCAT('%',#{data.yibaoOrderNo},'%') OR origin_orderno LIKE CONCAT('%',#{data.yibaoOrderNo},'%'))

if.test: data.type == '2'.toString() or data.type == '3'.toString() or data.type == '退款'

mapper.select:
SELECT id, transaction_time as transactionTime, order_no as orderNo, merchant_order_no as merchantOrderNo,po.specification, IF(type = 1, '收款', '退款') as type, COALESCE(IF(type = 1, amount / 100.0, NULL), 0) as income, COALESCE(IF(type = 2, amount / 100.0, NULL), 0) as expense, COALESCE(amount / 100.0, 0) as amount, COALESCE(service_fee / 100.0, 0) as serviceFee, product_name as productName, total_quantity as totalQuantity, order_user as orderUser, '' as orderUserPhone, IF(remark = '无', '', remark) as remark, orderno as yibaoOrderNo, origin_merchant_order_no as originMerchantOrderNo, origin_orderno as originOrderno FROM reconciliation_transaction_flow rtf LEFT JOIN product_order po ON po.order_no=rtf.order_no
ORDER BY transaction_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(0) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as incomeCount, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / 100.0 as incomeAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN service_fee ELSE 0 END) / 100.0 as totalServiceFee, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as expenseCount, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 2 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / 100.0 as expenseAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 2 THEN service_fee ELSE 0 END) / 100.0 as refundFeeReturn FROM reconciliation_transaction_flow

SELECT bill_date as billDate, COALESCE(SUM(total_income) / 100.0, 0) as transactionIncome, COALESCE(SUM(total_refund) / 100.0, 0) as refundExpense, COALESCE(SUM(fee_amount) / 100.0, 0) as transactionFeeExpense, COALESCE(SUM(fee_return_amount) / 100.0, 0) as transactionFeeReturn FROM reconciliation_transaction_summary
AND bill_date IN
#{id}
AND shop_id = #{data.shopId} AND bill_date >= DATE(#{data.startTime}) AND bill_date <= DATE(#{data.endTime})
GROUP BY bill_date ORDER BY bill_date DESC

SELECT bill_date as billDate, COALESCE(SUM(total_divide_amount) / 100.0, 0) as divideAmount FROM reconciliation_subledger_summary
AND shop_id = #{data.shopId} AND bill_date >= DATE(#{data.startTime}) AND bill_date <= DATE(#{data.endTime})
GROUP BY bill_date ORDER BY bill_date DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bill_date) FROM reconciliation_subledger_summary
AND shop_id = #{data.shopId} AND bill_date >= DATE(#{data.startTime}) AND bill_date <= DATE(#{data.endTime})
